mapper.select: select * from user_integral_details where user_id=#{userId} and str_to_date(create_time,'%Y-%m-%d')=str_to_date( #{time},'%Y-%m-%d') and classify=1

select * from(select sum(i.num) as sumNum,i.user_id as userId,u.user_name as userName from user_integral_details i left join tb_user u on u.user_id=i.user_id where i.`type`=1 and u.user_id is not null
and date_format(i.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d')=date_format(#{time},'%Y-%m-%d')
and date_format(i.create_time,'%Y-%m')=date_format(#{time},'%Y-%m')
and date_format(i.create_time,'%Y')=date_format(#{time},'%Y')
group by i.user_id order by sumNum ) a where sumNum is not null and userId is not null

select i.*,u.user_name as userName,u.phone from user_integral_details i left join tb_user u on u.user_id=i.user_id where 1=1
and i.content like concat('%',#{content},'%')
and u.user_name like concat('%',#{userName},'%')
and u.phone like concat('%',#{phone},'%')
and u.user_id=#{userId}
and date_format(i.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d')>=date_format(#{startTime},'%Y-%m-%d')
and date_format(i.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d')<=date_format(#{endTime},'%Y-%m-%d')
order by i.create_time desc
